title: Know the two main sides
summary: Electron's main process manages desktop windows.

Explain the example for know the two main sides

blocks.text: Electron's main process manages desktop windows. A renderer shows the HTML page inside a window, like a browser tab.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.

blocks.code:
Main process: creates and manages windows.
Renderer process: displays HTML, CSS and page JavaScript.
Preload script: exposes a small approved bridge between them.
blocks.title: Know the two main sides

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Window creation belongs in main, while visual page interaction belongs in the renderer.
Preload is a carefully limited bridge, rather than permission to expose all desktop functions.

blocks.text: The three roles help you decide where each kind of code belongs.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not give a page full Node.js access just to avoid designing a bridge.
